_comment: Editions listed in 'published' are built into data/v1 and offered by the app. Every other edition of the upstream catalogue is HELD: it can only be built locally with --all, and is never written to data/v1.

held_reasons.translations: Translators are mostly 'Unknown' and the upstream sources are third-party websites; no permission to redistribute has been shown. Held until each language has been reviewed.
held_reasons.ara-*1: Arabic 'diacritics removed' editions: the text differs from the diacritized edition (different source) and no source is stated. Held until provenance is known.
